macros.name: glossheading
macros.doc: Sets how the headings are formatted; it is redefined with \renewcommand.

macros.name: glosslinkcolor
macros.doc: You can control the appearance of gloss links with the following macros: \glosslinkborder, \glosslinkcolor, \glosslinkbordercolor (which correspond to pdfborder, linkcolor and linkbordercolor); you can change them with \renewcommand.

macros.name: glosspage
macros.doc: This command is used to print the page at the end of the gloss entry with refpages.

macros.name: ifglossshort
macros.doc: Use is made of \ifglossshort which takes the first argument if the short form exists, and the second one if does not exist.

macros.name: makegloss
macros.doc: This command in the preamble tells gloss to create a glossary.

macros.name: newgloss
macros.doc: For defining a new glossary use \newgloss.

macros.name: setglossgroup
macros.doc: Sets the heading corresponding to entries grouped by glsplain under the same group key (and preceded by \glossgroup, which in turn calls \glossheading).

macros.name: xglosspage
macros.doc: If the entry ends with a period, \xglosspage is used, which by default just maps to \glosspage.
